units.source_text: 薰大将只因微闻其事，故特来此探询。

en.t: General Kaoru had heard only a little of the matter, and so he came especially to inquire about it.

units.source_text: 现已证实这个久以为死亡了的人确系活着，

en.t: Now that it had been confirmed that the person long believed dead was truly alive,

units.source_text: 吃惊之余，但觉如同做梦，忍不住要流下眼泪来。

en.t: he was so astonished that it seemed like a dream, and he could hardly keep from shedding tears.

units.source_text: 但在这道貌岸然的僧都面前，毕竟不好意思露出此态，

en.t: But before this solemn and dignified bishop, he was too embarrassed to show such emotion,

units.source_text: 便改变想法，装作若无其事。

en.t: so he changed his manner and pretended that nothing was the matter.

units.source_text: 但僧都早已察知他的心事，想起薰大将如此疼爱此女，

en.t: But the bishop had already perceived what was in his heart, and thought how deeply General Kaoru had cherished this woman,

units.source_text: 而其人在现世已变得与亡人相似，都是自己的过失，获罪良多，

en.t: and how she had become in this world almost like one dead, all because of his own fault, for which he bore great guilt,

units.source_text: 便说道：“此人为鬼怪所缠附，也是不可避免的前世宿业。

en.t: and said, "That this person was possessed by a spirit must also have been unavoidable karma from a former life.

units.source_text: 想来她是高贵之家的小姐，

en.t: I suppose she is a young lady from a noble house,

units.source_text: 但不知因何失错而飘零至此？”

en.t: but I do not know what misfortune or error brought her wandering to this place."

units.source_text: 薰大将答道：“以出身而论，她也可说是皇家的后裔吧。

en.t: General Kaoru answered, "In terms of birth, she may indeed be called a descendant of the imperial family.

units.source_text: 我本来也不是特别深爱她的，只因偶然机缘，

en.t: It was not that I had loved her especially deeply from the beginning; by a chance connection,

units.source_text: 做了她的保护人，却想不到她会飘零到这地步。

en.t: I became her protector, but I never imagined she would be cast adrift to such a pass.

units.source_text: 可怪的是有一天影迹全无地消失了。

en.t: What was strange was that one day she vanished without leaving the slightest trace.

units.source_text: 我猜想她已投身水中，

en.t: I supposed that she had thrown herself into the water,

units.source_text: 但可疑之处甚多，在这以前一直不明实情。

en.t: but there were many doubtful points, and until now I never knew the truth.

units.source_text: 现在知道她已出家为尼，正可减轻她的罪孽，

en.t: Now that I know she has taken vows and become a nun, that should help lessen her sins,

units.source_text: 真乃一大好事，我心实甚欣慰。

en.t: and it is truly a great blessing; my heart is deeply comforted.

units.source_text: 只是她的母亲正在悲伤悼惜，

en.t: Only, her mother is still grieving and mourning for her,

units.source_text: 我将以此消息向她告慰。

en.t: so I shall console her with this news.

units.source_text: 但你的妹妹数月以来严守秘密，如今传述出去，

en.t: But your younger sister has kept the secret strictly for several months, and if it is now passed on,

units.source_text: 岂不违反了她的本意？

en.t: would that not go against her own wishes?

units.source_text: 母女之情是不会断绝的。

en.t: The bond between mother and daughter cannot be severed.

units.source_text: 她母亲不堪其悲，定将前来探访呢。”

en.t: Unable to bear her grief, her mother will surely come to visit her."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“我今有一不情之请：可否请你陪我同赴小野一行？

en.t: Then he added, "I have an unreasonable request: would you accompany me on a visit to Ono?

units.source_text: 我既闻知此女确悉，岂能漠然置之不理？

en.t: Now that I have heard definite news of this woman, how could I coldly leave the matter alone?

units.source_text: 她如今虽已出家为尼，我也想和她谈谈如梦的前尘。”

en.t: Although she has now become a nun, I would still like to speak with her about the dreamlike past."

units.source_text: 僧都看见薰大将神色非常感伤，想道：“出家之人，

en.t: Seeing General Kaoru looking deeply grief-stricken, the bishop thought, "Those who have left the world,

units.source_text: 自以为已经改变服装，断绝尘欲了，

en.t: may believe that by changing their robes they have cut off worldly desires,

units.source_text: 然而即使是须发都剃光的法师，也难保不动凡心。

en.t: yet even a priest who has shaved off beard and hair cannot be trusted never to stir with worldly feeling.

units.source_text: 何况女人之身，更不可靠。

en.t: How much less reliable, then, is a woman.

units.source_text: 我倘引导他去见此女，定将造成罪孽，如之奈何！”

en.t: If I guide him to see this woman, I will surely create sin. What am I to do!"

units.source_text: 他心中惶惑恼乱，终于答道：“今日明日有所障碍，未能下山。

en.t: Troubled and confused in his heart, he finally answered, "Today and tomorrow I have obstacles and cannot descend the mountain.

units.source_text: 且待下月奉陪如何？”

en.t: Would it do if I waited until next month and accompanied you then?"

units.source_text: 薰大将心甚不快。

en.t: General Kaoru was deeply displeased.

units.source_text: 但倘对他说“今天定欲劳驾”，急于欲行，

en.t: But if he said, "I must trouble you today," and pressed urgently to go,

units.source_text: 又觉得不成体统，便说：“那么再见吧。”

en.t: he felt that too would be improper, so he said, "Then, farewell for now."

units.source_text: 就准备回去。

en.t: Then he prepared to return.
